name: RustDesk
title: RustDesk: free TeamViewer alternative
hook: TeamViewer charges you twenty five bucks a month to control another computer from anywhere. This app does it for free.

features.say: Type in the other computer's ID, and you see its screen live, with your own mouse and keyboard.
Send files between the two computers in one window.

caption:
TeamViewer charges $24.90/month (billed yearly). RustDesk controls any computer remotely for free 💻

✅ See the other screen live and control it with your own mouse and keyboard
✅ Built-in file transfer between the two computers
✅ Works out of the box, or host your own server
✅ No subscription, no account, 100% free

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux · Android
ℹ️ Out of the box it connects through RustDesk's free public servers. You can host your own server too, and a paid Pro server exists for businesses.

Comment "REMOTE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
